description: This file defines the WinDnsSystemSettings structure and related functions for representing and retrieving Windows DNS system configuration, including DNS addresses, search lists, devolution settings, and policies.

classes.name: WinDnsSystemSettings
classes.description: Represents Windows DNS configuration including DNS addresses, search lists, devolution settings, and policies.

classes.name: DevolutionSetting
classes.description: Encapsulates devolution configuration with optional enabled and level parameters.

methods.name: IsStatelessDiscoveryAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IPAddress matches IPv6 stateless discovery addresses.

methods.name: GetAllNameservers
methods.description: Retrieves all configured DNS server addresses, excluding stateless discovery addresses.

methods.name: ReadWinSystemDnsSettings
methods.description: Reads DNS system settings from system registry and IpHelper, returning nullopt on error.
